svg.title: What one extraction call reads
svg.desc: Two bars drawn to the same scale, one for each of the two extraction calls in the example. Each call reads the same system prompt of 8,131 tokens. By characters, the system prompt is 2.5% role, 11.6% a description of the inputs, 40.1% guidelines on what to extract and how to write a memory, 38.5% eleven worked examples, 3.5% a final checklist and 3.7% the output format. Next to it, the user prompt with the conversation is a thin slice: 161 tokens for the first session and 434 tokens for the second, which also carries the five stored facts and the earlier messages.
svg.text: Each add() sends the same instructions, then the conversation. The bars are to scale: for a short session, the conversation
is a thin slice at the right end.
the system prompt: 8,131 tokens, the same on every call
the system prompt: 8,131 tokens, the same on every call
7 messages, the 5 stored facts and the 3 earlier messages
the seven slots of the user prompt, and the rule for dates
what to extract, how to write a memory, what never to do, linking
eleven worked examples (numbered 1 to 12, with no number 4)
Token counts from notebooks/02-mem0.ipynb; the prompt is mem0/configs/prompts.py, version 2.2.1
